name: workout-dumbbell-concept2
description: Clip-on cradle that mounts a rubber-coated dumbbell on a treadmill rectangular extrusion. v4: fork plate moved above the flange and tilted 15° to convert the load path from cantilever-bending (v3.4) to compression through the rail cap. Saddle at Y=54.5 mm, fork launch flush with flange-top (Z=0), single R=9 mm curved-arc strut, sleeve shortened to 30 mm, flat bell seat. CF-reinforced filament; Fusion 360 modeling (new file).

dimensions.note: Modeled bbox (Fusion 360, 2026-05-10 v2.1). x=88.5 (sleeve OD). y=118.46 (-31.25 sleeve back to +87.21 outboard tine bottom corner). z=50.75 (-38 plug bottom to +12.75 plate top, reduced from v1's 14.16 by R=2 fillet on plate +Y outboard top edge). v3.4 was 88.5×141.25×56 mm. v1 concept2 was 88.5×118.45×52.16 mm. Saddle now has a R=23 cylindrical bore along plate-Z direction through saddle center, providing shaft passage through the underside fill.

tolerances.note: 1.0 mm/side user-specified clearance on both plug and sleeve axes. CF-reinforced filament may shrink less than PLA — test pocket print required before full part. Project standard sliding fit is 0.35 mm/side; this is intentionally larger.

volume.note: v2.2 (2026-05-10): 220.37 cc — replaced the rectangular flange with a lofted body from sleeve OD (Z=-8, centered (0,0)) up to plate footprint (Z=0, centered (+2.5, +57.7)). Saddle U entry has a partial R=2 mm chamfer at the plate top face (4 of 9 edges) for shaft drop-in lead-in. Net vs v1: +21%. vs v3.4: −13%. Single watertight body.

lower_bell_clearance_check.status: ESTIMATED — flag for modeler to verify against actual dumbbell

params.sleeve_minus_x_wall_removed_reason: Treadmill control panel abuts rail −X face per reference photo. −X sleeve wall + corners removed for console clearance. Retained from v3.1.
params.fork_plate_launch_z_note: Inboard edge of fork plate flush with flange-top face (Z=0). User-confirmed Q1. Plate grows upward (+Z) as it extends outboard at 15° tilt.
params.saddle_center_y_derivation: sleeve_od_narrow/2 + saddle_radius = 31.25 + 23 = 54.5 mm. Inboard saddle arc wall kisses sleeve outer +Y face.
params.fork_plate_thickness_z_note: 12 × cos(15°) = 11.59 mm. Plate bottom at root: Z = 0 − 11.59 = −11.59 mm (inside flange zone). Strut arc tangent point B is on this surface.
params.fork_plate_x_note: Retained from v3.4 post-recentering. −X cut for console clearance; +X trimmed symmetrically.
params.bell_seat_surface_note: User-confirmed Q2. Flat plate top. Bell contacts plate at line contact. Chosen for printability over dish option.
params.strut_arc_radius_derivation: Solved tangency with both surfaces given plate underside at root corner (Y=34.35, Z=-11.59). R = 12 / 1.2588 - 0 = 9.531 mm. Spec's earlier 9.0 mm undershoots true tangency by ~0.5 mm.
params.strut_tangent_A_note: Flange-top outer +Y edge. Arc arrives vertically. Arc merges flush with sleeve outer +Y face at this corner.
params.strut_tangent_B_note: On fork plate underside, ~9.21 mm along the plate from the inboard root corner. Arc arrives parallel to plate underside (15° from horizontal). Smooth tangent merge — no kink.
params.strut_x_note: Full fork plate X width. Strut is a solid curved web, not two edge ribs. Matches fork plate X range.
params.shaft_length_note: Estimated for clearance check. User confirmed proceed with estimate (Q3). Modeler to verify against actual dumbbell once v4 prototype in hand.
params.bore_clear: confirmed — open end, no internal obstruction
params.vibration_retention_note: 15° tilt preloads upper bell against inboard saddle arc (horizontal component W×sin15°≈0.26W). Anti-walk by geometry — dumbbell cannot slide outboard without being physically lifted.
params.modeling_note: New Fusion 360 .f3d file. Do not reuse or branch from the v3.4 file (designs/workout-dumbbell-holder/). Build from scratch. Key modeling steps: (1) plug + flange + sleeve as a C-section shell, (2) fork plate as a tilted extruded body merging at the sleeve +Y face at Z=0, (3) strut arc as a 2D sketch in Y-Z plane (center 40.25,0, radius 9.0 mm, endpoints at tangent points A and B) extruded across full X width, merged with fork plate bottom and flange top.

testPrintCandidates.reason: 1.0 mm/side clearance chosen conservatively for CF-reinforced filament. Plug geometry is identical to v3.4 — the v3.4 plug-sleeve-stub test print (if already executed) remains valid. If not yet printed, a short plug stub (30 mm deep, full cross-section) must be test-fitted in the extrusion bore before the full v4 part. Gates all subsequent prints.

testPrintCandidates.feature: v4 fork plate — 15° tilt + R23 saddle arc
testPrintCandidates.reason: The tilted plate with saddle arc at a new position (Y=54.5 vs 90 mm in v3.4) is new geometry. A test piece capturing (a) saddle arc radius accuracy, (b) 15° plate tilt angle, and (c) flat plate top surface quality for bell line-contact seating should be printed before the full part. The v3.4 fork-plate-sample is superseded. Design deferred to test-print-planner stage.

testPrintCandidates.feature: Strut arc profile (R=9 mm curved web)
testPrintCandidates.reason: The R=9 mm concave-up arc spanning ~75° is untested geometry. A cross-section sample (short X-direction slice of the strut + flange corner + plate root region) should verify surface quality, tangency at both endpoints, and printability of the arc underside without support. Design deferred to test-print-planner stage.
